draft.reply_body:
Hi Riikka,

Welcome to Haapaharju! I'll check availability for the 1-tonne mini dumper and confirm — as with any booking, availability is only guaranteed once it's confirmed against our live system, so I'll get back to you with a firm answer shortly.

As a new customer, there's nothing complicated to set up. When you book, you'll need to pay a refundable damage deposit, which is standard for all machinery rentals — this is returned in full within five working days after the equipment is checked back in undamaged and complete. I'll let you know if anything else is needed once we've confirmed availability.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy
